name: rankSumDistribution
note: Sums are in doubled units (2 x rank sum) so tied, averaged ranks are integers. lower/upper are significant bounds: P(S <= lower) <= alpha/2, P(S >= upper) <= alpha/2, both attainable; null when none exists.
reference: exact integer-count convolution (Python), numpy.convolve, base R convolution (generate_rank_sum.R), Monte Carlo by row permutation
